native_reference.NCN_pretraining_and_loadmod: Part of author fit recipe, entirely absent from census.

random_schedule: All graph/control construction before reseeding; no models/parameters/dropout.
Seed Python random, NumPy, Torch CPU and all visible CUDA RNGs to 0.
One native negative_sampling call on full bidirectional TRAIN graph with unchanged defaults.
One exact native PermIterator CUDA randperm over official TRAIN record order.
For each of all 43 complete native batches, remove all 24,576 positive target records before symmetrization; same masked graph for positive and indexed negative queries.
Process positive then negative populations in consecutive 1,024-query chunks; no RNG or graph-mask change in chunk processing.

Tail 11,143 TRAIN record IDs and corresponding positive/negative query identities are digested but never scored or counted for support; retain these edges as visible context outside their unprocessed native tail mask.

teacher_semantics.G_full: Unweighted, undirected graph of acquired official TRAIN pairs only.
teacher_semantics.G_visible: G_full minus this complete native positive mask batch.
teacher_semantics.z_left: 1 iff (v,w) belongs to G_full for w in left
teacher_semantics.z_right: 1 iff (u,w) belongs to G_full for w in right
teacher_semantics.zero: Unobserved TRAIN incidence, not verified latent nonedge.
teacher_semantics.n: Number of distinct residual candidate identities on that side.
teacher_semantics.k: Observed TRAIN selected identities within that support.

source_equivalence_argument: No loops, no duplicate undirected TRAIN pairs and unit weights are bound by the acquisition receipt and checked in the worker.
The Boolean teacher is the same coalesced symmetric adjacency set as native SparseTensor.from_edge_index(...).to_symmetric().
Removing both directions of each masked unique TRAIN pair equals the native record-list mask before symmetrization.
With preedp=0 and cndeg/trndeg=-1, native adjoverlap computes exact intersection and side differences without support sampling. Boolean row operations implement those same sets.

Native sparse default negative sampling depends on edge membership/count, not the unacquired raw edge order; the existing qualified sampler source is reused and checked. No original raw-order tensor digest is claimed.
Query chunking performs independent reductions of rows of one fixed native masked adjacency; it neither drops candidates nor changes masks.

summaries.exact: Per-population/side n,k,r histograms, common-neighbor histogram, 3x3 strata table, both-variable/genuine fractions, empty/zero/full fractions, sum and maximum n*r, counts/query/permutation/draw digests.
summaries.cost_binned: Exact frequencies in explicitly bounded power-of-two intervals for n*r and combined-side n*r; no point precision inferred from a bucket.
summaries.timing: Native draw, positive/negative support counting and each full batch; whole worker wall, CUDA allocator peaks, Linux worker peak RSS.
summaries.storage: Stream compact per-batch summaries to JSONL, fixed-size accumulator histograms, no candidate identities, graph slots, logits or per-query vectors retained across chunks.

interpretation: These are support opportunities and prospective exact-CB DP cost predictors. They do not establish learned component differences, cross-side association strength or target ranking transfer. No ESP likelihood or learned head is executed.
runtime_limit: Reuse existing used package versions and exact native sampler source/function pin. No new exhaustive interpreter/stdlib/binary/pyc closure or runtime certification; root owns physical launch and observation.
